==English==

===Etymology===
From {{inh|en|enm|slowly}}, {{m|enm|slowli}}, {{m|enm|slouli}}, {{m|enm|slowliche}}, from {{inh|en|ang|slāwlīċe|t=slowly; sluggishly}}, equivalent to {{suf|en|slow|-ly|id2=adverbial}}. Compare {{cog|non|slæliga}}, {{m|non|sljóliga}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{rhymes|en|əʊli|s=2}}
* {{a|en|UK}}
** {{IPA|en|/ˈsləʊli/|a=RP}}
** {{IPA|en|/ˈslaːli/|a=Northumbria}}
** {{audio|en|En-uk-slowly.ogg|a=UK}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈsloʊli/|a=GenAm}}
** {{audio|en|en-us-slowly.ogg|a=US}}
* {{hyphenation|en|slow|ly}}

===Adverb===
{{en-adv|er,more}}

# {{lb|en|manner}} At a [[slow]] [[pace]].
#* {{RQ:Maxwell Mirror and the Lamp|chapter=5|passage=Then everybody once more knelt, and soon the blessing was pronounced. The choir and the clergy trooped out '''slowly''', {{...}}, down the nave to the western door. {{...}} At a seemingly immense distance the surpliced group stopped to say the last prayer.}}
#* {{RQ:en:CNN|author=Julia Horowitz|title=How meltdown in a $1 trillion market brought the UK to the brink of a financial crisis|url=https://www.cnn.com/2022/10/08/investing/uk-pension-funds-market-chaos|date=2022-10-08|passage=When bond yields rise '''slowly''' over time, it’s not a problem for pensions deploying LDI strategies, and actually helps their finances.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20240516121205/https://www.cnn.com/2022/10/08/investing/uk-pension-funds-market-chaos/}}

====Synonyms====
* {{l|en|ponderously}}, {{l|en|sluggishly}}, {{l|en|with leaden wings}} {{q|idiomatic, obsolete}}; See also [[Thesaurus:slowly]]

====Antonyms====
* {{l|en|quickly}}
* {{l|en|rapidly}}

====Derived terms====
{{col|en|slowlily|slowliness
|make haste slowly|please speak more slowly|slowly but surely|the mills of the gods grind slowly}}

====Related terms====
* {{l|en|slow}}
